description.zh: 吃醋巡检的温和版：定时看看你在做什么，用关心代替警告和锁应用。所有配置都在侧边栏面板里完成，工作流导入后不需要手改。
description.en: The gentle sibling of Jealous Guardian: periodic check-ins that express care instead of warnings and app locks. All settings live in the sidebar panel; the workflow needs no manual editing after import.

description.zh: 巡检工具 + 吃醋状态机：读配置、加醋、消醋、记日志
description.en: Patrol tools + jealousy state machine: config, add/reduce jealousy, logging
